data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'adon', meaning 'lord' or 'master'. The feminine form, 'Adonella', means 'lady' or 'noblewoman'. In Christianity, it is used as a variation of the name Adonna, which is derived from the Hebrew name Hannah. The name Adonella carries the meaning “Lady, Noblewoman” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Adonella usually hope their child will grow to embody lady, noblewoman and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adonella total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

historical_references.reference: The name Adonella is believed to have originated from the ancient Hebrew name Adonis, which means 'lord' or 'master'. In Greek mythology, Adonis was the god of fertility, hunting, and beauty, who was said to be the lover of Aphrodite. The name Adonella may have been given to a Christian woman in honor of this god, or as a derivative meaning 'little Adonis'.
historical_references.time_period: Ancient Greek and Roman period (circa 8th century BC to 5th century AD)

historical_references.reference: Another theory suggests that the name Adonella may have been a variant of the name Hadassah, which means 'myrtle tree' in Hebrew. In the Old Testament, Hadassah was the name given to Esther, a Jewish queen who saved her people from destruction at the hands of Haman. The name Adonella may have been given as a derivative of Hadassah, meaning 'my lady' or 'little Hadassah'.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Adonella, which is derived from the biblical figure Adonis, has seen modern usage in various contexts, particularly in the digital and tech industry. Adonella is now associated with three major platforms: OpenSea (a leading NFT marketplace), Decentraland (a virtual reality platform and decentralized application), and Twitter (a social media platform). In the context of NFTs, Adonella may refer to a specific digital artwork or collectible token. In the context of Decentraland, Adonella could be the name of a virtual estate or land parcel. On Twitter, Adonella might be the handle of an individual or organization. These modern contexts reflect broader trends in digital art, virtual worlds, and social media, where unique identities, collectibles, and community building are increasingly important.
